module, LED PCB, p86-87) draw, plus the final-assembly, A1, A2 and A6 parts
they stand for (Tables 5-1, 5-2, 5-3, 5-7). Refs are prefixed by their assembly
(A3Q1, A6BT1, A2J3, FPE6); final-assembly designators (F2, W3, W4, J1) are plain.
A3/A4/A5 designators copy desc/stock number from that board's parts.json and
link to it. A3/A4 test points (A3TP1-6, A4TP1-3) and A2 TP1/TP2 are in
sys.testpoints.json, not here. Errata Issue 3 (7/85) items carry notOnDrawing.

components.notes: Inside the oven. Reference amplifier U2/U1, output dividers, oven controller U3/U4/U5. Pre-regulator pass transistor, emitter follower clamping the raw dc to about 32 V (§3-11). TP6 after R1 on its emitter line.
Charger current source that supplies all the charging current (§3-27).
Q3 and Q4 form the charger's schmitt trigger; Q4 turns off at about 32 V battery voltage to end constant-current charge (§3-27, 3-28).
Q3 and Q4 form the charger's schmitt trigger; Q4 turns off at about 32 V battery voltage to end constant-current charge (§3-27, 3-28).

Constant-voltage trickle-charge source, about 27 V at 23 °C, set by R20 (§3-28). Emitter follower: TP5 is on its BASE node (CR28 / R16 / R17 / RT1 junction), the emitter leaves through CR16 to +BATTERY and the collector is fed from the charger supply through R4 / CR20 (Figures 8-3, 8-1).

In the +RAW line between Q1 and TP6 / P3-2. Figure 8-3 letters it ".5" (0.5 Ω); Table 5-4 prints 10M, as transcribed (and the errata repeats 10M). Stock no. 212191 in Table 5-4; later stock no. 717892 (Rev E, Errata Change #4), same part.
Sets the constant-current / constant-voltage transition threshold, §4-44 steps 16-21 (§3-28).

Jumper between the charger current source's output (the R3 / Q2 collector line that runs on through CR13 to +BATTERY P3-9/10) and the TP2 / P3-11 THERMISTOR line (the CR26 / CR14 / R11 node), Figure 8-3; on Figure 8-1 TP2 is the node left of W1 and the Q2 collector / CR13 line is on its right. Removed for the §4-44 charger adjustment (step 12, "on A2" in the 1983 text, corrected to A3 by Errata #8).

Figure 8-1 letters this potentiometer "R50". A3 has no R50 (Table 5-4 ends at R20; the Figure 8-3 REF DESIG box says last used R20). The pot in that position is R20, 50 kΩ, which §4-44 step 10 sets for 33.0 V at TP5 and which Errata #12 step 27 sets for 25.8-27 V trickle charge. Treat "R50" as R20.
Drawn on Figure 8-1 as an unlabelled thermistor symbol beside R17, hanging from the Q6 base node (TP5); A3's only thermistor. Compensates the constant-voltage charge for ambient temperature (§3-28).

Drawn on Figure 8-1 as the block lettered "TRANSFORMER" fed from the 3-pin line plug; lettered T1 only on Figure 8-3 (off-board, in the AC Module). Table 4-2: a shorted transformer means return to a Fluke Technical Service Center.

The bridge rectifier drawn on Figure 8-1 without a designator; CR1 RECTIFIER BRIDGE on Figure 8-3. TP3 is its + output (Figure 8-3; Figure 8-1 mis-draws TP3 on the transformer lead into the bridge - see caveat).

Not drawn on Figure 8-1 (Figure 8-3 draws it off-board beside T1). The rear-panel line fuse in fuseholder XF1: 3/8 A slow-blow for 100/120 V, 3/16 A slow-blow for 220/240 V per the rear panel and §4-27 (§2-19 prints 1/4 A; Table 1-2 prints 0.375 A / 0.250 A) - see the caveat.
Not drawn on Figure 8-1. The rear-panel fuseholder (Table 2-2 item 7).
Not drawn on Figure 8-1. AC LINE VOLTAGE SELECTION switch, positions 220-240V / 100-120V (Figure 4-5, Figure 8-3); set per §4-28 / §4-29 steps 1-8.
Not drawn on Figure 8-1. AC LINE VOLTAGE SELECTION switch, positions 100-220V / 120-240V (Figure 4-5, Figure 8-3); set per §4-28 / §4-29 steps 1-8.

Regulator Q1-Q4: conventional series pass / error-amplifier design regulating the 32 V to 18.6 V dc (§3-13). On Figure 8-1 the pass transistor Q4 sits between the -RAW rail (TP3, P2-23/24) and COMMON (TP2, P2-2..5).

Regulator Q1-Q4: conventional series pass / error-amplifier design regulating the 32 V to 18.6 V dc (§3-13). On Figure 8-1 the pass transistor Q4 sits between the -RAW rail (TP3, P2-23/24) and COMMON (TP2, P2-2..5).

Regulator Q1-Q4: conventional series pass / error-amplifier design regulating the 32 V to 18.6 V dc (§3-13). On Figure 8-1 the pass transistor Q4 sits between the -RAW rail (TP3, P2-23/24) and COMMON (TP2, P2-2..5).

Regulator Q1-Q4: conventional series pass / error-amplifier design regulating the 32 V to 18.6 V dc (§3-13). On Figure 8-1 the pass transistor Q4 sits between the -RAW rail (TP3, P2-23/24) and COMMON (TP2, P2-2..5).
Drawn on Figure 8-1 as the box "LATCH CKT Q6 Q7": the IN CAL latch. Q7 is the programmable unijunction transistor that stays latched off until RESET is touched to COMMON (§3-16).
Drawn on Figure 8-1 as the box "LATCH CKT Q6 Q7": the IN CAL latch. Q7 is the programmable unijunction transistor that stays latched off until RESET is touched to COMMON (§3-16).
Voltage monitor: turned on by the drop across the regulator pass transistor; when the output falls it turns off, shutting down the oven controller and the IN CAL indicator (§3-16).

Reference series pass transistor (PNP): emitter through R1 348 Ω to the 18.6 V bus, base on P2-8 (BLU, A5 E6, with R2 to the bus), collector on P2-7 (GRN, A5 E5) and through R3 24.3 Ω to P2-6 (YEL, A5 E4, the 10 V output line); P2-9 (VIO, A5 E7) is the CR13 / R21 bias for A5 Q1 (Figure 8-4). Figure 8-1 draws it again inside the A5 block as "A4 Q12 SERIES PASS ELEMENT" (§3-18, 3-19).

Oven heater driver and output transistors (§3-23). Heater current returns from A2 E2 through P2-1 (HEATER) into the EMITTER of Q14 (PNP), whose collector goes to COMMON; Q13 (PNP) drives Q14's base from HEAT DRIVE P2-26 through R26, with R24 (Q14 base-emitter) and R25 (Q13 base-emitter) on Figure 8-4.

Oven heater driver and output transistors (§3-23). Heater current returns from A2 E2 through P2-1 (HEATER) into the EMITTER of Q14 (PNP), whose collector goes to COMMON; Q13 (PNP) drives Q14's base from HEAT DRIVE P2-26 through R26, with R24 (Q14 base-emitter) and R25 (Q13 base-emitter) on Figure 8-4.
Drawn on Figure 8-1 without a designator: the diode from P2-15 (+BATTERY) to the 18.6V / +RAW line; Figure 8-4 letters it CR15.
5 kΩ pot at the Q1/Q2 error amplifier (Figure 8-1 draws the arrow). No adjustment procedure names it in the 1983 manual.

components.desc: Reference zener at the Q1/Q2 error amplifier, drawn CR2 on Figures 8-1 and 8-4; no CR2 line in Table 5-5
components.src: Figure 8-1 (p85); Figure 8-4 (p91); Table 5-5 has no CR2 (p58)
components.notes: Table 5-5 lists CR4 (1N4571, 6.4 V temperature-compensated zener) and no CR2; the schematic draws CR2 beside C2 and says CR4 is not used; the board drawing prints CR2. Errata Change #2 (A4 Rev C) renames CR1, CR2, CR9 to VR1, VR2, VR9, all 1N5240 (473744). Which parts-list line this diode is on a given unit is a caveat, not a guess - read the part. The A4 dataset carries CR2 as a notInParts item (aliases CR4, VR2); the link opens it.
Op amp that amplifies the Ref-Amp error voltage and drives the series pass element A5 Q1 / A4 Q12 (§3-19).

Drawn on Figure 8-1 as the box "SERIES PASS DRIVE TRANSISTORS A5 Q1, Q2". Q2 provides current limiting under short circuit (§3-19). Not field repairable (§4-54).

The OVEN TEMP THERMISTOR, 10 kΩ at 25 °C, wired to the front-panel posts E21/E22 (GRA, GRA). 3-4 kΩ at operating temperature, 3.8 %/°C (§2-35). Isolated from all other circuitry (§2-34).

Figure 8-1 letters this pot "10V ADJ" with no designator. Identified as R20 from Figure 8-5 (R20 100 Ω pot on the 732A-1007 ladder) and §3-19 ("Variable resistor R20 allows a small adjustment (±50 uV)"). Reached through the front-panel 10V access hole (Table 2-1 item 3).

Figure 8-1 letters this pot "1.018V ADJ" with no designator. Identified as R58 from Figure 8-5 (R58 200 Ω pot in the R56/R53/R52 chain, TP13/TP14) and §4-56 (errata: "Adjust R59 or R58 to get a reading of 1.0V or 1.018V (respectively)"). Front-panel 1.018V access hole (Table 2-1 item 1).
Figure 8-1 letters this pot "1V ADJ" with no designator. Identified as R59 from Figure 8-5 (R59 200 Ω 10-turn pot at TP12) and §4-56 (errata). Front-panel 1V access hole (Table 2-1 item 2).
